content.short: Matrixport, now trading as BIT, is a Singapore-based digital asset group offering trading, custody, lending and tokenized stocks and gold.
content.description: Matrixport was co-founded by Jihan Wu and has grown into a full financial services group, now under the BIT brand. Clients trade spot and structured products, buy tokenized US equities, and hold XAUm, its tokenized gold. Assets can be stored with Cactus Custody, the group's MPC custody arm. Fixed income and lending desks serve institutions and wealthier individuals, and stablecoin fiat ramps link the platform to bank accounts. Founded in 2019, the group says it looks after over $6 billion in client assets and handles more than $7 billion of trades each month. Its platform also offers US and Hong Kong stocks and STBT, a Treasury token.
